page: Microsoft Azure E8pds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an arm64-based Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor. The instance provides 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs running at 3.4 GHz without hyperthreading. Cache architecture includes 64 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 128 MB L3 cache pool. System memory is configured at 64.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage includes 472 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity, and the instance is provisioned with zero GPUs.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent throughput across general computing tasks, led by exceptional memory subsystems. The PassMark memory benchmark places the instance in the top 10% with a score of 3220.54, complemented by uncached read bandwidth reaching 169.19 GB/sec and single-threaded gzip compression in the top 25% at 33.15 GB/sec. General CPU metrics, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 9448.0 and stress-ng multi-core result of 16569.49, reside in the middle 50% category. In-memory datastore evaluations record 16.56 million Redis SET operations per second and 10021.8 on PassMark database operations.

The primary architectural tradeoffs relate to compute-intensive workloads that rely on specialized instruction sets. Due to the ARM Neoverse-N2 design, x86-oriented vector and matrix extensions such as AVX, AVX-512, and AMX are absent. This impacts execution profiles for AI inference, resulting in lower-tier throughput such as 12.34 tokens per second on 7B prompt processing and bottom 25% performance on PassMark encryption tests. However, the high memory-per-core density and bundled high-speed NVMe storage yield solid cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require GPU hardware.

The E8pds_v6 is well suited for relational databases, Redis caching layers, data processing pipelines, and memory-intensive web applications requiring fast scratch storage. The combination of dedicated ARM physical cores and rapid NVMe scratch space makes it a stable platform for containerized enterprise software stacks.
